name: Public Correspondence Agent
headline: Answer every part of every resident letter from approved wording
pitch: Give correspondence officers one queue for letters, emails, web forms and phone notes, a breakdown of every separate question, cited approved answers, and a clear referral for anything new, while officers stay in control of every reply.
why_try: The demo walks one multi-part resident letter from the queue to a cited draft reply, with the unanswered question routed to the right team and nothing sent.
customer_challenge: Correspondence teams answer high volumes of multi-part resident enquiries across many channels; parts get missed, approved wording is rewritten, and new questions stall while ownership is worked out.
microsoft_ai_story: Copilot Studio and Microsoft Teams give officers the assistant; approved correspondence records, a SharePoint library of approved responses and the team directory can be bound with least-privilege access, while Outlook stays the officer's own sending channel.
business_value: Every question in a resident enquiry is addressed before a reply goes out.
Approved wording is reused with a citation instead of rewritten.
New questions reach the owning team quickly and become reusable precedent.
business_flow: Residents writing by letter, email, web form or phone
Correspondence officers in Microsoft Teams or Microsoft 365 Copilot
Approved correspondence records and response library
Officer review, sign-off and sending in Outlook
